title: I’m making a Black & White-style god game with Claude writing all the code and ChatGPT on design. Here’s where it’s at.
author: RiordanRacer
selftext:
I’m Riordan. I’ve always wanted a modern Black & White, so I’m building one: a voxel god game where you’re the hand in the sky over a village that believes in you.

How it’s made:

* **Claude** writes all the code (Unity 6, C#). I describe what I want, test it, and send back what’s broken or doesn’t feel right.
* **ChatGPT** helps with design ideas and art concepts.
* **Me:** game design, playtesting, and deciding what stays and what goes.
* The music in the clip is AI-generated too.

Some things in it right now:

* Pick up villagers, trees and rocks, throw them, shape the land
* Your people react to what kind of god you are. Zoom in close and they look up at your hand and cheer, or cower if you’ve been cruel.
* Rival gods with their own towns. They send gifts, envoys, champions or lightning depending on how they feel about you.
* Raiders who yield can be spared, executed or locked in a stockade, where they glare up at you
* Eras from camp to city, miracles, rituals, champions who lead your war bands

The biggest lesson so far is that the AI is fast at building systems, but feel is still on me. Things like whether a rock sounds real when it lands, or whether a menu is ugly, only get caught by playing it.

It’s free on itch, and I read every comment and every message on the Discord. Happy to answer anything about the workflow.
